children: Welihinda Navam, an officer serving as Chief Financial Officer, sold 8,961 ordinary shares at $87.78 per share on 2026-09-09 for a total of $786,596 to satisfy tax withholding obligations related to the vesting of restricted stock units and performance-based RSUs, and after the sale Navam directly owns 200,293 ordinary shares.

Mark Eugene Dodds, an officer serving as Chief Revenue Officer, sold 9,673 ordinary shares at $87.78 per share on 2026-09-09 for a total of $849,095 to satisfy tax withholding obligations related to the vesting of restricted stock units and performance-based RSUs, and after the sale Dodds directly owns 288,538 ordinary shares.

Kulkarni Ashutosh, a director and the Chief Executive Officer, sold 29,227 ordinary shares at $87.78 per share on 2026-09-09 for a total of $2,565,546 to satisfy tax withholding obligations related to the vesting of restricted stock units and performance-based RSUs, and after the sale Kulkarni directly owns 599,525 ordinary shares.
